name: Chemical & Allied
source: CRON 20261014: Chemical and Allied Products Plc Q2 2026 earnings release for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Performance Summary, printed in million naira and scaled to naira. The release prints six months columns and every identity holds: revenue 22,410 less cost of sales 12,727 equals the printed gross profit 9,683; gross profit 9,683 less the printed operating expenses 6,112 plus the printed other operating income 241 equals the printed operating profit 3,812; that plus the printed net finance income 637 equals the printed profit before tax 4,449; and less the printed income tax expense 1,513 equals the printed profit after tax 2,936. Cost of sales is not printed as a row and is taken as revenue less the printed gross profit. Net finance costs are stored negative because the period earned net finance income. Basic earnings per share stored in naira from the printed 360 kobo. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com)

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: EPS
rows.formula: Net Profit / weighted average shares implied by the company's own reported EPS
